purpose: Human review of disagreements between TextCNN predictions and benchmark labels.
important_rule: The benchmark label remains unchanged. Review fields record analyst assessment and do not overwrite ground truth.

review_outcomes.clear_model_error: The benchmark label is substantially better supported by the available text than the model prediction.
review_outcomes.plausible_model_prediction: The model prediction is semantically reasonable, although the benchmark label is also defensible.
review_outcomes.ambiguous_label_boundary: Two or more emotion labels are strongly defensible from the available text.
review_outcomes.possible_annotation_mismatch: The available text appears to support the model prediction substantially more strongly than the benchmark label.
review_outcomes.insufficient_context: The sentence does not contain enough context to confidently adjudicate the benchmark/model disagreement.

mechanism_tags.negation: Negation may materially affect the interpretation of the sentence.
mechanism_tags.sarcasm_or_irony: Literal wording may not reflect the intended emotional meaning.
mechanism_tags.rare_label: The disagreement involves a relatively rare emotion class.
mechanism_tags.mixed_emotion: The text contains evidence for multiple emotions.
mechanism_tags.preprocessing_artifact: Tokenization or preprocessing may obscure important information.
mechanism_tags.lexical_bias: One or more strong lexical cues may dominate the model decision.
mechanism_tags.other: A mechanism not covered by another tag.
